expected: the Jevellan web app "CM5 owner terminal connected" screen at phone-light, rendered completely and legibly (one of several screens captured during "CM5 owner terminal reconnects, relays, copies command records and returns owner actions in every layout"; the other steps are judged in their own screenshots)

cosmetic: The key row (Esc, Tab, Ctrl, Alt, arrow keys) runs past the right edge, so the last key is only partly visible. It looks like a horizontally scrollable strip, so the remaining keys can likely be reached by scrolling, but nothing on screen clearly shows that.
The terminal wraps words mid-word at its column width (for example "r oot" and "rl / m3jp"). This is normal terminal wrapping but slightly harder to read on a narrow screen.
The connection path in the header is cut short with an ellipsis ("/tmp/jevellan-browser-rlm3jp/..."). This is an intentional truncation, and the full path also appears in the shell prompt.
